newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST -Danish crown seen stable in 1997.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST -Danish crown seen stable in 1997.

text.p: The Danish crown is expected to remain stable throughout 1997, strengthening during the first six months but ending the year virtually unchanged from its present level, an average of 14 analysts' forecasts shows.

The Reuters consensus survey predicted that the crown would trade at 3.8400 to the mark by the end of March 1997, falling to 3.8467 in six months and would be 3.8632 next December. At 1200 GMT on Monday it was 3.8263 to the mark. --Claus Mathisen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969651
